messages:
ash-ops: Heads up — seeing a recurring pattern of streaming blackbox probe connection resets in us-central1 since ~15:10. p99 latency jumps + grpc resets. logs show `grpc: connection reset by peer`.
ash-ops: Timeline: 15:10 start, peak 15:25, tailing off 15:40. probes hit ~3.8x normal p99.
mike-sre: can you paste the prom query you used? also which probe type? streaming or embeddings?
ash-ops: streaming (websocket/grpc streaming), 1s payloads simulating 64-token streams. Query I ran: `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(probe_stream_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))` and `sum(rate(blackbox_probe_errors_total{region="us-central1",type="streaming"}[5m]))`
yang-observability: saw the same in the Grafana panel — but interestingly p50/p90 barely budged, p99 exploded. suggests tail bursts not steady load.
opsbot: deploy: svc/inference-streaming-usc attempted restart 3 times between 15:18-15:22 — reason: OOMKilled on gpu-worker-3.
ash-ops: Correlation: GPU pod OOMs + probe resets. Hypothesis: KV cache pressure + transient memory spikes on large-model shards.
lucy-ml: Which model variants were serving there? Could be long-context Llama-2-70B v1 pinned on that pool.
mike-sre: two parts to triage: 1) stop noisy alerts -> switch to quantile/ratio alerts; 2) stop probe-induced amplification.
mike-sre: proposal for alert change (temp): alert if relative tail increases vs baseline, not absolute p99. Sample rule:

````
- alert: BlackboxStreamingTailIncrease
  expr: 
    increase(sum(rate(blackbox_probe_errors_total{type="streaming",region="us-central1"}[10m]))[30m:10m]) / 
    (sum(rate(blackbox_probe_errors_total{type="streaming",region="us-central1"}[6h])) + 1) > 0.25
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: warning
  annotations:
    summary: "Streaming probe errors: tail increase in us-central1"
````

mike-sre: and for latency use a ratio-based alert: `probe_stream_latency_seconds{quantile="0.99"} / probe_stream_latency_seconds{quantile="0.5"} > 6` for sustained 5m
yang-observability: good idea. We can add a panel that shows p50 / p99 ratio over time to spot these tail events without pager noise.
ash-ops: operationally I also want to reduce probe sampling on that pool to avoid adding load. Suggest: lower streaming probe rate from 1s -> 5s for the us-central1 shard where GPUs are constrained.
lucy-ml: careful — fewer samples reduces detection fidelity for real regressions on streaming SLAs. maybe multiplex probes: 1s probes but short-circuit after handshake if KV warm? or probe with smaller token counts to be cheaper.
mike-sre: tradeoff note: streaming probes cost ~3-5x compared to tiny embedding probes (token budget). We should move some health checks to a cheaper synthetic embedding check for capacity-only gating, keep a smaller subset as full streaming canaries.
nash-ops: agreed. Action items:
- yang: add p50/p99 ratio panel and implement the ratio alert (dev onboard)
- mike: add the relative-tail alert rule and reduce sensitivity to absolute p99 for 24h
- ash: throttle streaming probe frequency on affected us-central1 probe fleet to 5s and create a canary set of 3 probes that keep 1s rate for fidelity
- lucy: generate a small eval comparing failure signal when using tiny token streaming vs full token streaming (cost delta)

mike-sre: quick note on dashboards — add a panel with `sum by (region,model_variant) (probe_stream_kv_cache_misses_total)` so we can see cache pressure driving OOMs.
yang-observability: will do. Also adding a grafana annotation for the OOM restart times to make correlation explicit.
opsbot: alert: BlackboxStreamingTailIncrease fired at 15:22 (duration 12m) — silenced by mike-sre (24h)
ash-ops: thanks. will follow-up with a short postmortem if the canary set trips again. :thumbsup:
